note: The three protocol choices the title prices, each with the dump it is computed from.

rectification.what: reference-mean rectification: the output's brightness is set from the reference before scoring

eight_bit_rule.what: rounding versus truncation when saving 8-bit output

dataset_rendition.what: the Sony extreme-dark set is distributed in at least two renditions with different pixel conventions

caveat: The three are priced on different sample sizes: rectification on 598 Sony frames and two LOL checkpoints, the 8-bit rule on three LOL checkpoints, the rendition on one checkpoint over 598 frames. They are not a single 18-pair sweep.
